line.name: Davidoff Chefs Edition 2025
line.description: 4th installment of Davidoff's ongoing 'Chefs Edition' collaboration series, created with 5 Michelin-starred chefs (11 stars total): Paolo Casagrande, Christian Bau, Kirk Westaway, Nick Bril, Michael Beltran. Not one of the brand's long-running core lines.
line.filler: All-Dominican - San Vicente (aged 15 years), a Dominican hybrid leaf, and Piloto tobacco aged 5 years in yagua palm leaves
line.status: limited edition (2025 run, 17,500 boxes worldwide, 5,600 to the US)
